subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Place value (numbers to 99)
source.subtopic: Decompose two-digit numbers into multiples of tens and ones up to 80 (weeks 1-2) and 99 (weeks 5-6, 9-10); use flard cards / place value cards daily

show.line: Look at 43. Four tens and three ones. Forty and three make forty three!

rounds.prompt: Tap the number that is five tens and two ones.
rounds.praise: Yes! Fifty and two is fifty two.

rounds.prompt: Count the bundles of ten. How many tens in sixty?
rounds.praise: Six tens! Six tens make sixty.

rounds.prompt: Which card shows the tens in 38?
rounds.praise: Yes! The three in 38 is worth thirty.

rounds.prompt: Seventy six. How many ones? Say the number.
Twenty and nine. Tap the number they make.
rounds.praise: Yes! Twenty and nine make twenty nine.

rounds.prompt: Tens or ones? Put each card in its group.
What is the four worth in 84?
rounds.praise: Yes! The four is in the ones place. It is worth four.

hints: The first digit tells you the tens. The last digit tells you the ones.
Say the number slowly. Forty three is forty and three.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will break 65 into tens and ones.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! 65 is six tens and five ones. Sixty and five.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Six tens is sixty. Add five ones. Sixty five!

parent_line: Can break a two digit number into tens and ones.
